instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-icons, clsx, tailwind-merge, canvas-confetti.
Create a toggle switch in the UI header to switch between 'Multi-step Flow' and 'Single-page Flow' to satisfy the user's request to see both.
Implement the Glassmorphism sticky order summary panel on the right side (desktop).
Use Instrument Serif for all headings (H1, H2) and Manrope for body text. Load these from Google Fonts in index.html.
For the Installment Simulator under the Credit Card method, use a Shadcn Slider component (1 to 12 steps) and dynamically update the summary text (e.g., '12x de R$ 90,75').
The Success Screen must include a confetti animation (using canvas-confetti) and a 'Baixar Comprovante PDF' button.
Ensure Dark Mode is fully supported, prioritizing deep navy (#020817) over pure black, and highlighting accents in OAB Red (#C8102E).
